body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Mateo from Buenos Aires, full of excited tactical discoveries. Voice direction: The voice of Mateo himself: high and slightly breathy, words tumbling quickly with excitement, pitch jumping up on each discovery; light Argentine accent. Not squeaky. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Wait, wait, look at this! Who's guarding that piece now? Nobody! The defender moved away, so the other side can just take it. So sneaky!
